parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Response format. Accepted values: `json`, `dggs+json`, `geo+json`, `html`, `parquet`, `geoparquet`. Defaults to content negotiation via the `Accept` header.

parameters.name: zone-depth
parameters.description: Relative depth of child zones to aggregate. Accepts a single integer (e.g. `1`) or a comma-separated list (e.g. `1,2`). Defaults to the DGGRS-defined default depth.

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: Temporal filter in RFC 3339 format. Accepts an instant (`2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`) or an interval (`2024-01-01/2025-01-01`). Open-ended intervals use `..` (e.g. `2024-01-01/..`).

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of queryable names to include in the response (e.g. `ndvi,evi`). Returns all queryables when omitted.

parameters.name: exclude-properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of queryable names to exclude from the response. Applied after `properties`.

parameters.name: refined-geometry
parameters.description: Densify zone geometry by interpolating additional points along edges. Relevant for geo+json and geoparquet formats. Default: false.

parameters.name: cog-url
parameters.description: URL of an arbitrary COG to query directly. Used on the /dggs/{dggrs_id}/zones/{zone_id}/data route (no collection). Bypasses collection lookup and caching.

parameters.name: cog-stat
parameters.description: Comma-separated statistics for a cog-url query (e.g. mean,min,max). Accepted values: count, valid, min, max, mean, median. Defaults to mean.

parameters.name: cog-band
parameters.description: Comma-separated 1-based band indices to read (e.g. 1,2,3). Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: cog-no-data-value
parameters.description: Override the COG no-data value. Pixels equal to this value are excluded from statistics. Applies to all raster sources (STAC, URL, direct COG). Overrides the collection-level default.

parameters.name: cog-sampling-factor
parameters.description: Sampling density multiplier relative to zone count. Higher values increase accuracy. Defaults to 8.0.

parameters.name: cog-all-touched
parameters.description: When true, include pixels whose boundaries are only touched by zone polygons. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: stac-search-strategy
parameters.description: STAC search strategy: `single` (default), `latest`, or `mosaic`. `latest` takes the newest item with no intersection check; `single` takes the newest item individually meeting the intersection threshold; `mosaic` accumulates items newest-first until their combined footprint reaches the coverage target (requires a `datetime` range). Overrides the collection-level default.

parameters.name: intersection_percent
parameters.description: Intersection percentage (0–100) of the parent zone. For `single`: minimum that the chosen item alone must cover (`0` disables the check, default). For `mosaic`: total combined coverage target (unset = 100%). Ignored for `latest`. Overrides the collection-level default.

parameters.name: cloud_cover_percent
parameters.description: Maximum `eo:cloud_cover` percentage (0–100) allowed for STAC items. Omit to disable the filter (default). Overrides the collection-level default.

parameters.name: collection_id
parameters.description: Collection identifier

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 10, max 1000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-based row offset into the lake parquet; numberMatched - limit pages the tail of the data

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Spatial filter min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y (CRS84 lon/lat); rows whose geometry intersects the box. Uses bbox_* zonemap columns and/or ST_Intersects on the geometry column

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: Temporal filter on the datetime column: RFC 3339 instant or interval (start/end, start/.., ../end)

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated columns to keep (geometry is retained for geojson/geoparquet unless excluded explicitly)

parameters.name: exclude-properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated columns to drop

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: CQL2 filter expression over the parquet columns, e.g. population > 10000 AND name LIKE 'A%'

parameters.name: filter-lang
parameters.description: Language of filter: cql2-text (default) or cql2-json

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Format: geojson (default, FeatureCollection), json (raw inspection view with files, columns and WKB previews), html (table view), parquet (page as a parquet file), geoparquet (page as GeoParquet)

200.description: One page of the collection's raw lake parquet rows

404.description: No parquet data in the lake for this collection

CollectionSelectionBody.description: One collection's selection: which fields, optionally filtered and renamed.

alias.description:
Overrides the `id` as the output column prefix. Needed to list the same
collection twice (e.g. under two different filters), which would
otherwise collide on `id__field`.

fields.description:
Fields to return from this collection's schema. Required and non-empty:
there is deliberately no wildcard, so the response column set does not
silently change when a collection's schema gains a field.

oneOf.description:
A CQL2 predicate restricting which of this collection's source rows
contribute to each zone's value. Only supported for DuckDB-backed
collections.

collections.description: One entry per collection to read from. Must not be empty.

FeatureCollectionResponse.description: OGC API Features `getFeatures` response over the collection's lake parquet.

FeatureResponse.description:
A single GeoJSON Feature read from the lake parquet. `id` is the 0-based
row index in glob scan order (the raw parquet carries no guaranteed id
column) — only stable while the lake prefix doesn't change.

FileInfo.description: One parquet file under the collection's lake data prefix with its row count.

FilterSpec.description:
A CQL2 filter in either encoding. A JSON object is CQL2-JSON, a string is
CQL2-Text; the JSON type discriminates, so no `filter-lang` is needed.

RawItemResponse.description: Raw inspection view of a single row (`/items/{feature_id}?f=json`).

source.description: The `read_parquet` glob the row was read from.

RawItemsResponse.description:
Raw inspection view (`f=json`): rows exactly as they sit in the lake
parquet (geometry as a truncated WKB hex preview), plus the file list and
row counts a local `SELECT * FROM read_parquet('s3://…')` would show.

source.description: The `read_parquet` glob the rows were read from.

SchemaProperty.description: A single property in JSON Schema format, per OGC API - Features Part 3 §7.3.

SchemaResponse.description: OGC JSON Schema response used by both `/schema` and `/queryables`.

bbox.description: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] per OGC DGGS API spec

centroid.description: [lon, lat] per OGC DGGS API spec
